articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 with Native Multimodal Reasoning and Extended Context
articles.summary: OpenAI officially released GPT-5 in late April 2026, featuring natively fused vision, audio, and text reasoning in a single architecture rather than stitched-together modules. The model demonstrates significant gains on graduate-level science benchmarks and supports a 1M token context window, enabling full-codebase and long-document analysis workflows that were previously impractical.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Ultra 2 Achieves State-of-the-Art on Agentic Coding Tasks
articles.summary: DeepMind unveiled Gemini Ultra 2 with dramatically improved agentic capabilities, scoring over 75% on the SWE-Bench Verified benchmark for autonomous software engineering. The model can plan multi-step repository changes, run tests iteratively, and self-correct, narrowing the gap toward fully autonomous software maintenance for production codebases.

articles.title: Figure Robotics Begins Commercial Deployment of Figure 03 Humanoid in BMW Factories
articles.summary: Figure AI started deploying its third-generation humanoid robot at BMW's Spartanburg plant for general-purpose material handling and sub-assembly tasks. The Figure 03 units operate alongside human workers with improved dexterity and a new foundation model for task adaptation, marking one of the first scaled commercial humanoid deployments in automotive manufacturing.

articles.title: Boston Dynamics Atlas Shows Autonomous Disaster Response in DARPA Field Trials
articles.summary: Boston Dynamics demonstrated its electric Atlas humanoid performing fully autonomous search-and-rescue operations during DARPA's latest Robotics Challenge field exercises. The robot navigated collapsed structures, manipulated debris, and carried simulated casualties without teleoperation, leveraging a new perception stack built on real-time 3D scene reconstruction and LLM-driven task planning.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces Constitutional Steering for Enterprise AI Governance
articles.summary: Anthropic released a new framework called Constitutional Steering that allows enterprises to define domain-specific behavioral policies for Claude models using structured natural-language constitutions. The system enables fine-grained compliance guardrails for regulated industries like healthcare and finance, with auditable decision traces that map outputs back to specific constitutional clauses.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of A14 2nm Chips Ahead of Schedule
articles.summary: TSMC announced that its N2 (2nm) process node has entered high-volume manufacturing at the Kaohsiung fab, several weeks ahead of the originally projected timeline. The gate-all-around transistor architecture delivers a roughly 25% performance uplift at iso-power versus N3E, with Apple and Nvidia among the first customers expected to ship consumer products on the node later this year.

articles.title: Microsoft and Quantinuum Demonstrate Fault-Tolerant Logical Qubit Operations at Record Fidelity
articles.summary: Microsoft and Quantinuum published results showing 14 fault-tolerant logical qubits operating with error rates below 10⁻⁸ per logical gate cycle, a roughly 100x improvement over their 2025 milestones. The advance, built on Quantinuum's trapped-ion hardware and Microsoft's qubit virtualization layer, brings practical quantum error correction closer to enabling real algorithmic advantage for chemistry and optimization problems.

articles.title: Meta Releases Llama 4 Behemoth as Open-Weight Model with MoE Architecture
articles.summary: Meta publicly released the weights for Llama 4 Behemoth, a 288B-active-parameter mixture-of-experts model with over 1.5 trillion total parameters, under a permissive license. Benchmarks place it competitive with proprietary frontier models on reasoning and coding tasks, intensifying the debate around open-weight model safety while giving the open-source ecosystem its most capable foundation model to date.
